claim: The Rubens House main historic building remains closed for renovation and is not expected to fully reopen until 2030; only the garden, library, and Rubens Experience multimedia centre are accessible.
quote: the Rubens House is currently closed due to a thorough renovation and is expected to reopen in 2030

claim: Phase one of the Rubenshuis renovation reopened the garden and a new reception area, with the Rubens Experience and library accessible during the works.
quote: Rubens Experience, the library and the garden are already buzzing with activity

claim: KMSKA (Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp) opens 10:00-18:00 on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays and is closed Mondays (per separate weekday schedule).
MAS galleries open Tuesday-Sunday 10:00-17:00, while the rooftop boulevard and panorama stay open until 22:00 — perfect for a free post-museum sunset view.
quote: The museum galleries and the Visible Storage are open for visit: Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. The boulevard and panorama are open Tuesday to Sunday from 9:30 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.

claim: Antwerp's Cathedral of Our Lady opens to tourists Sunday 13:00-17:00 only (mornings are reserved for services); standard adult ticket is €12.
quote: Sunday: 1 pm - 5 pm ... Standard individual ticket: €12 per person

claim: Het Steen's visitor centre and panoramic rooftop are free; only the Antwerp Story interactive exhibit costs €7, with the building open from about 10:00 to 17:00.
quote: Access to the visitor center and the panoramic rooftop is completely free for everyone. You only need to pay the entrance fee of €7

claim: Trains from Duffel to Antwerpen-Centraal run hourly (often more) on the SNCB network, covering ~15 km in roughly 24 minutes for €3-7 one-way.
quote: Belgian Railways (NMBS/SNCB) operates a train from Duffel to Anvers-Central hourly. Tickets cost $3-7 and the journey takes 24 min.

claim: Zurenborg, developed 1894-1906, packs a dense cluster of Art Nouveau and fin-de-siecle townhouses around the Cogels-Osylei/Transvaal/Waterloo 'golden triangle' east of the centre.
quote: Zurenborg is an area in south-east Antwerp largely developed between 1894 and 1906 that features a high concentration of townhouses in Art Nouveau and other fin-de-siecle styles

claim: A self-guided Zurenborg walking loop runs ~2 km and roughly two hours including cafe stops, reachable on tram 6/11 or by train to Antwerpen-Berchem.
quote: Plan to spend about two hours walking the 1.5-kilometer route

claim: Het Eilandje is Antwerp's regenerated old harbour district with the MAS, Red Star Line Museum and Port House clustered along restored docks, 20-30 min walk from the historic centre.
quote: Between the historic warehouses you will discover the modern architecture of the MAS, the Red Star Line Museum and the new Port House

claim: DIVA, Antwerp's diamond, jewellery and silver museum, opens daily 10:00-18:00 except Wednesdays — notable for being open on both Sunday and Monday.
quote: DIVA is open daily from 10:00 to 18:00 hours, except on Wednesdays

claim: Red Star Line Museum (Eilandje) opens Tuesday-Sunday 10:00-17:00 and closes Mondays, telling the story of 19th/20th-century European emigration to America.
quote: open Tuesday through Sunday from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. and is closed every Monday

claim: MoMu Fashion Museum opens Tue-Sun 10:00-18:00, closed Mondays, but is undergoing maintenance from 4 May 2026 through March 2027 so visitors should verify status.
quote: maintenance works are scheduled from 4 May 2026 until the end of March 2027

claim: Snijders & Rockoxhuis, a 17th-century patrician house museum on Keizerstraat, opens Sundays 10:00-17:00.
quote: Snijders&Rockoxhuis in Antwerp is open on Sundays from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM

claim: FOMU (Fotomuseum Antwerpen) in Het Zuid opens Tuesday-Sunday 10:00-18:00, closed Mondays.
quote: FOMU is open Tuesday - Sunday from 10 - 18 hours

claim: The Plantin-Moretus printing complex is a UNESCO World Heritage Site (inscribed 2005), the only surviving Renaissance/Baroque printing workshop and publishing house in the world.
quote: the only surviving printing workshop and publishing house in the world dating back to the Renaissance and Baroque periods

claim: Museum Plantin-Moretus opens Tuesday-Sunday 10:00-17:00 and is closed Mondays, like most major Antwerp city museums.
Het Zuid south of the centre concentrates KMSKA, M HKA and FOMU along leafy boulevards with weekend-busy cafe terraces around Marnixplaats and the Museumstraat.
quote: Het Zuid has some of Antwerp's most prestigious art institutions, and the Museum of Contemporary Art Antwerp (M HKA) is a highlight

claim: A classic self-guided Antwerp walking route links Het Steen, Grote Markt, the Cathedral, the Meir shopping street and ends at Antwerp Central Station, easy to do in a single Sunday afternoon.
quote: Antwerp: Walking Tour From Steen to Central Station
